title: What Keeps Me Curious
description: I’m drawn to things that combine exploration, endurance, creativity, and understanding how systems work.

items.title: Photography
items.description: Photography is my creative outlet and a way to explore atmosphere, detail, and composition. I enjoy outdoor, travel, and cinematic-style photography, always looking for interesting angles rather than simply documenting places.

items.title: Hiking
items.description: I enjoy mountain hiking, winter conditions, and challenging trails that combine endurance, adrenaline, and exploration. For me, hiking is about pushing limits, discovering new routes, and spending time far from everyday routines.

items.title: Cycling
items.description: Road cycling is one of my favorite ways to disconnect, stay active, and explore new routes. The rhythm of cycling is where I think through complex problems.

items.title: Travel
items.description: I prefer road trips, city breaks, and active travel where I can keep moving and discovering. I travel to understand cultures, architecture, and everyday life — not just tourist spots.

items.title: Linux & Self-Hosted Tech
items.description: Arch Linux has been my primary operating system for over a decade. Running self-hosted servers, experimenting with AI infrastructure, and building homelabs keeps my systems thinking sharp between product cycles.

items.title: Home Labs & Automation
items.description: I build practical things at home — sensors, automations, dashboards, and side projects that keep my engineering instincts sharp outside product work.
